notes: Jednotky ve Stormbound používají jediný atribut 'Strength', který zároveň funguje jako útok i zbývající zdraví — pole 'attack' a 'health' jsou proto u jednotek nastavena na stejnou hodnotu Strength. Stavby mají Strength jako 'health' (attack null, pokud stavba sama neškodí). Kouzla mají attack/health null. Všechny číselné hodnoty jsou na úrovni 1 (základní). Wiki na Fandomu byla nedostupná (HTTP 402 přes proxy), data pochází z fanouškovské databáze stormbound-kitty.com; barvy frakcí jsou přibližné a nebyly nezávisle ověřeny.

factions.name: Ironclad
factions.description: The Ironclad Union: a rock inhabited by clever, industrious rodents and the Constructs they build. Plays around ranged damage, defensive structures, and strength-boosting synergies between Rodents and Constructs; strong, steady board development but lacks a dedicated game-winning finisher.

factions.name: Swarm
factions.description: The Swarm of the East: the oldest kingdom, home to the undead and their Satyr thralls. Built around fast aggression, going wide across the board, and sacrifice/death-trigger synergies; excellent early aggression but weak in the late game.

factions.name: Winter
factions.description: The Winter Pact: Dwarves and Frostling spirits of the frozen north. Focused on control, freezing enemies, mana ramp, and powerful late-game payoffs; the strongest control and late-game faction, but vulnerable to fast starts and weak at low card levels.

factions.name: Shadowfen
factions.description: The Tribes of the Shadowfen: an unusual alliance of Toads and Ravens dwelling in the swamps. Specializes in poison, strength-draining, and board-control removal; strong presence and removal but no dedicated win condition of its own.

factions.name: Neutral
factions.description: Cards usable by any faction/deck, spanning many unit tribes (Pirates, Knights, Felines, Elders, Dragons, Hero units, etc.). Offers broadly useful utility and some of the game's strongest commons and legendaries, but faction decks generally outperform pure-neutral strategies.
